extensions.source: Theme::dark() in crates/peel-ui/src/theme.rs; widgets in crates/peel-ui/src/widgets.rs and chrome.rs. Peel Studio is a native Rust/wgpu app: the html/css below are documentation previews only and are not shipped.

body.purpose: Default UI text and text fields.

readout-small.purpose: Levels and numeric fields, tabular figures.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Only under floating layers: menus, tooltips, sheets, drag previews.

motion.name: meter-ballistics
motion.value: fast attack, ~20 dB/s release, 1.2 s peak hold

focusRing.value: 2px focus outline, 1px outside the control, radius + 1px

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Orange fill for the one primary action in a region, such as Export or Run.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 24px; padding: 0; min-width: 80px; background: #F7992B; color: #1F1305; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F7992B 92%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F7992B 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7FC8EA; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Control fill for dialog buttons and dropdown values in property rows.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 24px; padding: 0; min-width: 80px; background: #35322E; color: #F3EEE4; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #423E39; } .ds-btn:active { background: #504B45; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7FC8EA; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line field on the seam color with a strong line; the stroke turns focus cyan while editing.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; background: #0C0B0A; color: #F3EEE4; font: 500 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; border: 1px solid #403C37; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8F887C; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(110, 196, 230, 0.7); }

components.name: Pane Tab
components.description: Text tab in a 32px pane header; the selected tab gets a 2px amber underline and widths never change with selection.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 32px; background: #1A1917; border-bottom: 1px solid #2D2B28; } .ds-tab { padding: 0 10px; background: none; border: none; color: #B9B2A6; font: 600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #F3EEE4; } .ds-tab-on { color: #F3EEE4; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #F7992B; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7FC8EA; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: The front panel of a Roland TR-808 and the drum machines that followed it: a warm black panel, cream legends, and step keys in red, orange, yellow and cream, four to a beat. Peel Studio takes that palette and its sense of hardware, not its artwork, on a pattern-and-playlist workspace with compact toolbars and continuous editing surfaces. The chrome stays quiet. Clips, notes, lit steps, waveforms and the playhead are the brightest things on screen, and a channel's color identifies it everywhere it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Panes meet at a 2px bg seam instead of floating as cards
Panes, editor canvases and mixer strips are square; controls use 2-4px radii
Orange for the primary action and playhead; green for signal
Channel colors only on musical content, never on chrome
Controls you press or turn are lit from above and lit lamps have a small halo; panes and text carry no gradients; shadows only under floating layers
dos: Do take hierarchy from value steps and 1px separators.
Do keep one primary (orange) button per region.
donts: Don't nest surfaces more than one deep.
Don't use focus cyan for text.
Don't put channel colors on chrome.
